segments.zh: 不仅如此，他们还在谈论婚礼，他们在谈论金钱。

segments.en: So this is a very interesting way to talk about these very common topics, personal life, love and especially money.
segments.zh: 所以这是一个非常有趣的方式来谈论这些非常常见的话题、个人生活、爱情，尤其是金钱。

segments.en: But remember, in American culture, these are the kinds of things you would only talk to your friends about.
segments.zh: 但请记住，在美国文化中，这些是您只会与朋友谈论的事情。

segments.en: You wouldn't really want to talk to strangers about money, personal life, marriage, because those are considered private.
segments.zh: 你真的不想和陌生人谈论金钱、个人生活、婚姻，因为这些被认为是私密的。

segments.en: So be careful when you're talking to people you don't know very well.
segments.zh: 因此，当您与不太了解的人交谈时要小心。

segments.en: That's right.
And actually, your feedback was very interesting when we discussed about if it's okay to ask, for example, a woman her age or her weight or a man's salary.
segments.zh: 实际上，当我们讨论是否可以询问同龄女性或体重或男性的薪水时，您的反馈非常有趣。

segments.en: So in most places, you said that it wasn't really correct.
segments.zh: 所以在大多数地方，你说这不是真的。

segments.en: But this is the very interesting thing about the cultural differences and what is appropriate to talk about.
segments.zh: 但这是关于文化差异以及适合谈论的内容的非常有趣的事情。

segments.en: That's right.
So again, if you have any questions or comments about the things we talked about here today or any of our older lessons about small talk, please just let us know.
segments.zh: 再说一次，如果您对我们今天在这里讨论的事情或我们关于闲聊的任何旧课程有任何疑问或意见，请告诉我们。

segments.en: Our website is EnglishPod.com.
All right, guys.
We'll see you there.
Bye. Bye.
